campaign: Complete integrated platform validation, then transfer validated audio.cpp behavior into reusable audio primitives and composable ingest-train-evaluate-serve recipes
doctrine: Operator override (2026-09-04): do not merge master while its tokenizer and continuation-scoring memory fixes await verification. The DSP reference step proceeds on audio baseline 19ceb5d9; its paired sync row records retained-baseline reconciliation, not a master merge. Do not execute later master-sync rows until the fixes have verified evidence. Every retained work row executes as one repeated automation cycle. First run go run ./cmd/plan -prepare-merge master -plan-projection first-parent-target; when master is not already contained, finalize the injected merge row with the exact cmd/gate -merge command printed by the owner so master code and source-store evidence enter while the audio plan remains the explicit reconciliation target. Second inspect the merged repository, query its authorities instead of inferring them, and reconcile every affected remaining row; commit the paired sync row through cmd/gate. Third perform only the paired work row and run its declared verifier. Fourth commit that work row through cmd/gate, which records evidence and prunes it atomically; then restart the cycle from the current master tip. Raw git merge, raw git commit, implementation before the paired sync row, and carrying a plan assumption across a master merge are refused. Each sync row inherits the paired work row's original dependencies, and the work row depends only on that completed sync authority. The retained integrated-validation rows remain the capability-freeze prerequisite and run before audio implementation; this branch does not evade or discard open master obligations. After they complete, audio.cpp and the downloaded reference repositories are pinned behavioral oracles and mechanism sources; each is never a linked runtime, hosted server, package manager, or permanent product dependency. The transfer unit is a verified processing capability: source commit, license and artifact identity, decoded-signal admission profile, explicit compatibility decision, neutral typed contract, intermediate golden traces, Go CPU reference, manifest-owned CUDA where measurement justifies it, recipe-selected consumer, evaluation evidence, and deletion of temporary comparison adapters. Granite Speech 5.0 470M TurboCTC is the first ASR oracle because native Safetensors offline inference passed the pinned LibriSpeech fixtures. Nemotron 3.5 ASR native Safetensors is the materially different streaming ASR oracle; its downloaded NeMo-Speech Q8 GGUF is a valid container but an incompatible tensor schema and must be rejected explicitly rather than guessed from its extension. FireRedVAD is the first offline and streaming segmentation oracle because both checkpoints passed the same decoded fixtures. No family name enters shared executors. Schema, headers, duration, and transcript metadata never establish usable audio: admission decodes samples, measures signal content, and quarantines silent, near-silent, corrupt, clipped, non-finite, or otherwise policy-invalid records before evaluation or training. The historically silent AMI materialization remains quarantined pending exact source and transformation identity; this is not a blanket claim about the non-silent available AMI source shard. Pinned LibriSpeech clean is the initial positive dataset. Forward parity precedes backward implementation, while task, artifact, state, and checkpoint contracts retain the information required for gradients, deterministic replay, trainable-parameter selection, and optimizer state. The campaign is not complete when inference runs: its proof is the composed recipe ingest to decode to validate to segment to transcribe to score to materialize to train to benchmark to publish to serve, with exact stop and resume preserving optimizer, random and data-stream state, a pre/post WER bracket and complete OvergoDB lineage. CPU is the numerical authority. CUDA enters only through kernels/manifest.json and must match the CPU contract on the same artifact and fixtures; unavailable or unsupported toolchains are reported as unavailable, never as passing evidence. Streaming work owns bounded sessions, cancellation, chunk-boundary invariance, finalization, discontinuity, and backpressure. Every quality or performance claim names its artifact, dataset, environment, denominator, latency, throughput, host memory and VRAM. Signal validation and VAD land in the first ASR lifecycle because they protect evaluation and training materialization; later ASR architectures, alignment, diarization, voice, and generative-audio rows remain gated so breadth cannot hide an incomplete lifecycle. Findings outside this scope are recorded but do not expand the campaign. While GPU capacity is reserved for other work, dispatch CPU development and CPU verification before device implementation, VRAM measurement, general model benchmarks, and device-bearing recovery drills; the commit gate may use the GPU whenever its derived scope requires device evidence. The CPU tranche includes oracle intake, neutral contracts, signal admission, DSP, CPU ASR, VAD, recipes, transcription serving, WER, dataset materialization, backward execution, exact resume, the second CPU ASR architecture, live CPU operations, alignment, diarization, and reusable voice-contract consolidation.

steps.title: Execute the pinned benchmark set with raw-completion anchors and template-aware answer scoring; for every chat-template choice suite prove one rendered case, print the first answer beside its candidates, and refuse an unrenderable or all-unmatched protocol; then report per-protocol committed scores, sourced references, throughput, commit identity, wall time, and missing evidence
steps.rationale: evaluate -all derives models and suites from the store, orders servable models smallest-first, enforces the six-hour total budget with per-remaining-model slices, and reports geometrically spaced per-suite progress with running score and timing. Evaluation plans bind prompting protocol so unlike passes cannot overwrite one identity. The raw-completion MMLU anchor remains comparable with lm-eval. Master d75d3554 completed the generated-letter protocol by parsing chat-template control tokens as special tokens and recognizing end-of-generation markers by token name; cc4485a0 records the corrected MMLU comparison. Master c36e5b70 renders BBH, MuSR and other text candidates as lettered options while leaving existing letter candidates direct; 4a642032 refuses an unrenderable suite at plan time, prints the first generated answer and its candidates, and stops after an all-unmatched eight-case probe instead of recording zero. Master 03f08dd2 drops instantiated CUDA graph execs whenever captured device memory is released; complete Qwen3.5 4B and 9B chat-template passes must cross the prior BBH failure windows and therefore serve as the long-run replay-safety proof as well as quality measurements. Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-12B and Qwen3.8-27B now score near or above their raw anchors, while base, long-thinking and explanation-prone models retain bounded unmatched counts. The generated report derives all servable models and their latest per-protocol evidence from OvergoDB, prints missing measurements, and keeps published references as sourced declarations. The remaining broad suite includes MMLU and MMLU-Pro, TruthfulQA, IFEval, sequence likelihood or perplexity, retrieval quality, and applicable multimodal evaluation.

The sweep must report prefill separately from decode and include widths immediately below, at and above every applicable boundary, with CPU numerical authority retained.
